notes.title: We're at TGAGWCAGA 2024
notes.notes:
Candy Rangers will be featured in TGAGWCAGA 2024—The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards! This indie showcase is streaming this Friday, December 13th!

TGAGWCAGA highlights indie games while also poking a little fun at the exclusivity of The Game Awards.

Subscribe now to TGAGWCAGA’s YouTube channel so you don’t miss out!

📅 TGAGWCAGA 2024
🕔 Friday, December 13th
5:00 PM UTC / 6:00 PM CET / 12:00 PM ET
📺 Watch the stream here: https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA

We’ll also be part of the TGAGWCAGA Steam Event running from December 13th to December 22nd, featuring tons of amazing indie games—including ours!

Make sure to join us this Friday, tell your friends and wishlist your favorite titles!

notes.title: DEMO - SAGE24 and October Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hello! As promised, Here's the announcement for this week!

A new demo will be available to download and play at SAGE24, a digital event where small developers come together to showcase their projects.

In addition to SAGE, we will also be at Steam's October Next Fest! So there will be another demo right on Steam the month after SAGE. This demo will be a little different than SAGE so don't worry, you won't be playing the same levels!

That's all! See you next week at SAGE24!

notes.title: We're at the middle point
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! Mechano here.

Sorry for the radio silence on Steam. It's my first game on Steam and I'm not familiar with all the tools. You can expect more updates from me going forward. Anyways,

We're at the middle point! [b]Half the main levels[/b] and a few levels of the later areas have been made. There have been a few changes since we started production. For instance, there were no bosses planned for the main areas of the game. I had initially planned to only make a final boss to at least have a last hurrah at the end.

However, back in summer I decided that it was feasible to at least have a boss per area. [b]One of them is already fully implemented[/b] and I plan to implement a new one as I work on the third area, then go back to the first area and add the missing boss (and continue with the final area as usual).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851013/d0c403c6a2d9eb0d9f5e0736cc63e73185a409a2.jpg[/img]

That's all I'll say today, I have [b]another update to post next week[/b] so stay tuned! You'll be able to play this game very soon!
